title: [PTRun][Calculator] Persist copied results without a post-write OLE flush

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The latest serialized direct-MSBuild diagnostic exited zero but did not execute CsWinRT. Cleanup ran before the projection output directory was initialized, attempted relative response-file cleanup, and left the existing response file unchanged; incremental evaluation then skipped projection as up-to-date. This explains the latest no-op, not the original projection failure. No downstream build or test ran. The lock was released after the command ended. A guarded sequence that initializes the output directory before targeted cleanup and forces one actual projection execution is being prepared; the original failure remains unresolved.
